svg.title: Titration curve
svg.desc: pH against volume of titrant for a weak acid titrated with a strong base. The curve rises slowly through a buffer region, passes through pH equal to the pKa at half the equivalence volume, then rises steeply to an equivalence point above pH 7. Illustrative data.
svg.text: Weak acid with strong base: pH = pKa at the half-equivalence point
pKa is read at the half-equivalence point, not the equivalence point.
